subject: Re: Request for Test Environment Access
text:
Hello Leo,

I hope you’re doing well.

We are evaluating annotation platforms for an upcoming *automotive ADAS
project* focused on *3D LiDAR-based Object Detection and Pedestrian
Detection (ODPD)*.

To determine whether your platform is a good fit, I’d like to confirm
whether your annotation tool supports the following capabilities:

*1. 3D LiDAR Annotation*

   -

   Native visualization and annotation of high-density LiDAR point clouds
   -

   Creation and editing of oriented 3D bounding boxes (cuboids)
   -

   Support for vehicle-based coordinate systems (e.g., X forward, Y left, Z
   up)

*2. Multi-Sensor Support*

   -

   Time-synchronized playback of LiDAR and camera data
   -

   Camera imagery used as contextual support for classification (no 2D
   image labeling required)

*3. Temporal Object Tracking*

   -

   Persistent object IDs across frames (track-level annotation)
   -

   Object lifetime, age, and trajectory visualization

*4. Kinematic Attribute Support*

   -

   Automatic or assisted computation of object velocity, acceleration, yaw,
   and yaw rate
   -

   Relative motion attributes between ego vehicle and targets

*5. Semantic Attributes*

   -

   Configurable object classes (e.g., vehicle, pedestrian, bicycle)
   -

   Support for attributes such as occlusion level, visibility percentage,
   movement state, lane assignment, and CIPV indicators

*6. Ego Vehicle Data Integration*

   -

   Ingestion of ego vehicle motion data (speed, acceleration, yaw, pitch,
   roll)
   -

   Synchronization between ego data and object annotations

*7. Quality Control & Validation*

   -

   Built-in QA workflows (annotator/reviewer/QA roles)
   -

   Attribute validation rules and audit trails

*8. Data I/O*

   -

   Import of raw sensor data formats (e.g., LiDAR streams)
   -

   Export of structured outputs (e.g., Parquet or similar tabular formats)

If available, we would also appreciate:

   -

   A brief product overview or documentation with me an

subject: Re: Encord invite
text:
Hello Hugo,

Wednesday 10am EST works for us. I have added Melody (Data Ops manager) in the thread.

To help the conversation move forward, here are our main evaluation criteria

- Text annotation only (unstructured / semi-structured text)

- Configurable UI that adapts to evolving schemas (incl. taxonomy / hierarchy with explicit UI support)

- Simple labeling: mainly binary + multi-label

- Multi-annotator workflow: 2+ annotators per item

- Built-in QA + adjudication: side-by-side comparisons, flag <100% agreement, resolve to a final label

- In-tool metrics & prioritization: inter-annotator agreement + annotator stats; disagreement-first navigation

- Task distribution: assignment / load balancing, fixed N annotators per item, reviewer roles; minimal manual batch/file handling

- Security & access: private-data friendly, RBAC; SSO preferred (SAML/OAuth)

- Deployment: SaaS or self-hosted; low operational overhead

If you have time for a targeted demo of text classification (no span selection) and a quick review of QA features, that would be great.

Talk to you Wednesday,

Alexis
